facts.claim: In 2026 Kraków charges no local fee (opłata miejscowa) or tourist tax: Polish law allows the local fee only where climate, scenic value and tourism conditions are all met, and the City of Kraków's tourism office says most municipalities, Kraków included, do not meet them.

sources.title: City of Kraków convention bureau, 26 May 2026: Actions taken by Kraków to introduce a tourist tax

articles/where-to-stay-in-krakow.html: Not charged in Kraków
So a visitor staying in 2026 pays no city fee
most municipalities, Kraków included, do not meet those conditions

facts.claim: A Polish amendment to the local taxes act, passed by the Sejm on 18 Sep 2026 (Senate: no amendments, 24 Sep; President's signature recorded 15 Oct 2026), applies from 1 Jan 2027: a council may introduce a local fee in places with landscape value of up to 5.00 zloty a person a night (5.50 in spa-protection areas), set by council resolution and collected by the accommodation provider; the Council of Ministers is to set minimum landscape qualities by regulation. No Kraków council resolution was found.

sources.title: Sejm legislative record, government print 3099 (with prints 2033, 2127, 2872)
Text of the amendment as passed by the Sejm (Art. 17, Art. 11)
OKO.press, 16 Oct 2026: the tourist fee will take effect, the President has signed

articles/where-to-stay-in-krakow.html: up to 5 zloty a person a night from 1 January 2027
the legislative record shows the President signing it on 15 October
the Council of Ministers still has to set the minimum landscape qualities by regulation
we found no Kraków council resolution
